summary:
Submitted a final alignment product that removes the last stale statement in the map.

Context from the index: three findings are confirmed_in_scope, the restart check is accepted as a bounded negative, the heartbeat-handler exploration is recorded, map v13 is the accepted basis, audit units are exhausted, and pending_work is empty.

The issue: the A2 activity still carried the question of whether the heartbeat fast path changes authority-observation ordering, which the behavior-level work has since answered and narrowed (only pure heartbeats reach the off-thread handler; the fields they touch are individually serialized; an exploration observed the handler answering while running and dropping the request after a clean shutdown). One object should not keep an answered suspicion after its owner has been updated.

Product contents (draft-relative submission.json with the updated map.json): a clarification of the A2 activity so its unknown now states exactly the residual the owning behavior carries — whether the (setState, setCurrentTerm) pair can be observed as a term regression by an external reader under a concurrent campaign — with purpose, realization summary, entry points, variants and sources unchanged. The feedback records the answered premise and the surviving frontier: that term-regression question, the election-restriction chain, the FSM consistency question, the pre-vote, TimeoutNow and recovered-index residuals, the possible transport cost of the unanswered shutdown heartbeat, and the two out-of-snapshot questions. No behavior, fact, edge or confirmed finding changes.

Preflight `validate` returned valid=true with no diagnostics. Acceptance and the final map version remain with the controller.
